content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: BVSc & A.H / M.V.Sc from any recognized Institutions. Age limit: Below 65 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: The post is a resident post; the selected candidate must reside at Malkangiri. The officer shall be active, energetic & willing to move in and around Forest area. Candidates possessing a Master's degree and experience in wildlife management shall be given preference. Desirable: Master's degree and experience in wildlife management and treatment of any herbivores & carnivores

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The post is purely contractual and does not confer any rights for regular appointments. Initial engagement shall be for a period of 06 (Six) months, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: How Will Malkangiri Forest Division Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Examination (Objective Type - MCQs) Interview Written examination shall comprise Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) carrying maximum 60 marks. Interview carries maximum 40 marks. Top five (05) candidates shall be shortlisted based on written examination merit for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format Updated resume Self-attested copies of educational qualifications Experience details along with the certificates Valid Email ID and Mobile Number

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Malkangiri Forest Division Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format from the official website. Prepare updated resume and self-attested copies of educational qualifications. Include experience details along with certificates. Submit applications to the office of the undersigned on or before 05 PM of 27.10.2026 through Email / Registered Post / Speed Post / Courier.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The merit list shall remain valid for a period of one (01) year from the date of declaration of results.
